_comment: Example Viam component config for the viam:ethercat:a6-servo motor model.
The drive's object dictionary (PDO map, counts/rev, gear) is CONFIG DATA; the
A6 vendor residuals (fault-reset, no-SYNC0 code, gloss) live in the a6-servo
0x1A00=6656 on SM 0x1C13=7187. Set "simulate": true (or interface "sim") to
run against the in-memory SimBackend with no NIC/hardware.
#61: control_mode (PP|PV|switchable) is an intent -- the driver DERIVES the
standard CiA402 map, so rxpdo/txpdo below are an OPTIONAL advanced override
(shown here as a worked example), not required. #59: reached/is_moving is
position-stability based (Delta-position over N cycles); position_tolerance_counts
is optional (default counts_per_rev/720 ~= 0.5deg) and velocity_threshold is an
optional override -- no velocity-noise-floor tuning needed.
name: servo
